missionPremise: Smart Site ships internal engineering language to customers and styles correct behaviour so it reads as failure. Operator QA pass 2026-08-18, verbatim: 'there is a lot of irrelevant text in the black box, most of the info (inside the parenthesis) is not valuable to the consumer... it seems to be our personal info where we pull the data from' and 'the data box on the left of the screen looks like its displaying error messages'. The second is the load-bearing one: the Travis County card was CORRECT. Grey italic 'not verified here' was the system honestly refusing to invent facts outside stamped coverage, styled exactly like a failure. The system was right and the design was lying about it. Binding source: _catalog/parcel_fact_sheet_contract/CONTRACT_RULES.md invariants I3 and I4, FROZEN 2026-08-18 by the planner. The contract was not edited.
completionPredicate: On a parcel card a stranger can (a) find no internal work-item, gate, or pipeline vocabulary on the consumer surface; (b) read a value without its sourcing welded into it, and still reach that sourcing in one interaction; (c) tell an honest absence apart from a failure without being told which is which; (d) see an already-saved property offer Remove rather than Save; and (e) a fresh clone's CI fails if any source file reintroduces double-encoded mojibake. All five met; (d) is met with a named cross-lane seam, recorded under openItems.
scopeBasis: Six lanes edit this repo in parallel. This lane owns the RENDERING of InspectCard plus TerrainExportSection / PropertyBriefPanel / SmartFilesMountStub / SitePlanExportSection, and the CI guard it adds. Lane P-39 owns InspectCard's DATA SOURCE, all of src/lib/**, SearchBar.tsx, ExplorerMap.tsx and api/**; lanes P-41 and P-42 own packages/map-renderer/**. Every change here is presentation-side or a net-new file. Where a fix required a file owned elsewhere, it was reported rather than taken — twice, both listed under findingsRoutedNotTaken. Ownership was verified mechanically, not asserted: `git diff --name-only 5bf06ec..HEAD` filtered against the ownership set returned nothing outside it.

workItems.item: Remove SmartFilesMountStub from the consumer surface
workItems.detail: Verified at source before deleting: a repo-wide grep showed exactly one import and one usage, both in InspectCard.tsx. The component file was therefore deleted rather than only unmounted. api/pe-smart-files-mount.ts and its 4 passing tests are untouched, so the probe remains reachable without shipping to customers.

New `FactPresentation` union (the render mirror of the frozen `Fact<T>`), `splitWeldedProvenance` and `toFactPresentation` at the render boundary, and a `SourcesDisclosure` reusing the existing SetbackXrayDetail idiom. The row shows the value; every source key, vintage and derivation method sits one tap away. The always-visible line dropped 'gate-passed' and kept the record date.

workItems.item: I4 — failure is not an absence
workItems.detail: Five states, five registers, each stamping its own data-state so the distinction is structural as well as visual. Coverage claims are opt-in per row so a derived or identity row never claims a coverage gap.

`isSaved` and `onUnsaveProperty` props added, mirroring the isSubject pattern eleven lines above. The control relabels to 'Saved · Remove' and stays ENABLED — unlike make-subject, the opposite of save is an action, and the dispatch called for unsave in place rather than a trip to My Properties. Because ExplorerMap.tsx belongs to P-39, the prop is optional and the card self-resolves through the one saved-properties flow when it is absent.

Seven mojibake occurrences plus a UTF-8 BOM repaired in TerrainExportSection.tsx. Guard at scripts/check-source-encoding.mjs plus .github/workflows/source-encoding.yml, on every PR with no path filter.

`resolveCardHeading` treats a candidate with no letter or digit as not-an-address and falls through to the parcel number, then to 'Selected parcel'. A designed caption reads 'No street address on the county record'. Root cause confirmed at source: packages/map-renderer/src/live-gis.ts `selectionToCard` passes any non-blank string through, so a lone quote character on the county roll became the entire header.

absenceTreatmentsBeforeAfter.note: Rendered from the shipped component and pasted verbatim, not described from memory. Probe test written, run, output captured, probe deleted; working tree verified clean afterwards.
absenceTreatmentsBeforeAfter.before: All three of absent-covered, absent-uncovered and unresolved rendered as `color: var(--semantic-absence); font-style: italic` with the text 'not verified here', plus one grey sentence reading 'Not verified in this area: land use, zoning and setbacks.' Three greyed rows and a grey sentence, in one register, is what the operator read as three error messages.

after.markup: <dd style="margin:0;color:var(--surface-muted, #94A3B8)" data-state="absent-covered" data-absent="true">no zoning value on record here</dd>

<dd style="margin:0;color:var(--semantic-absence, #7C8BA0);border-bottom:1px dashed var(--semantic-absence-border, rgba(124,139,160,0.35));display:inline-block;line-height:1.35" data-state="absent-uncovered" data-absent="true">no zoning stamp here</dd>

absenceTreatmentsBeforeAfter.coverageBlock: The grey sentence became a bordered dashed block headed 'Not stamped in this area yet', reading 'We have not stamped zoning and setbacks for this area. Fills in from a zoning district stamp from this parcel's city or county and a published setback table for this parcel's zoning district.' It is styled as a designed state rather than a warning, and it names what would fill each gap (I4).
absenceTreatmentsBeforeAfter.errorBlock: The failed-read block moved from muted grey to a bordered error register and gained a working 'Try again' that re-runs the read in place. Its copy previously ended 'Reselect the parcel to retry — this is not an honest absence', which is an internal workaround and an internal distinction shown to a customer.
absenceTreatmentsBeforeAfter.judgeThis: The planner's question is whether an absence still reads as an error. The two absences no longer share ANY style property with the unresolved state: neither carries the error hue, neither is bold, neither is italic, and the retired 'not verified here' string is gone from both. The only row wearing the error hue is the one that genuinely failed.
